remarks: Beautifully furnished annual rental in the heart of Westport, CT. This spacious 3-bedroom residence offers 3 full baths and 1 half bath and has a flexible floor plan with two additional rooms that the current owner has been using as bedrooms. It has been thoughtfully designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining. The light-filled interior features generous living spaces, tasteful furnishings throughout, and a dedicated home theater with a movie projector and Bose surround sound system-perfect for movie nights and game days. The fully equipped kitchen and cozy bedrooms provide comfort for the whole family. Step outside to an exceptional private oasis with resort-style outdoor amenities. The beautifully landscaped property includes a sparkling swimming pool, lush gardens, an outdoor kitchen with BBQ, and an extra-large dining table ideal for summer meals and celebrations. Multiple outdoor seating areas invite relaxation, including a spacious outdoor daybed with curtains for privacy, two outdoor fire tables, and a ping-pong table-perfect for entertaining guests of all ages. Ideally located close to Westport's beaches, downtown shops and dining, the train station to NYC, and cultural attractions such as the Levitt Pavilion, this peaceful retreat offers the very best of Westport living-combining luxury, convenience, and refined indoor-outdoor living.
